proposals.title: REPORT ON RISKS OF GULF COAST PETROCHEMICAL INVESTMENTS
proposals.proponent: As You Sow, on behalf of Amy Devine and Douglas Triggs, and the Rita K. Devine Irrevocable Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report, omitting proprietary information, assessing public health risks of expanding petrochemical operations in areas prone to climate-change storms, flooding and sea level rise.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD RECOMMENDS THAT YOU VOTE AGAINST THE PROPOSAL.
